parties.petitioner: Revenue Divisional Officer, Chevella Division & Ors.

summary: Challenge to land resumption under Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfer) Act, 1977; applicability of Section 3 to lands assigned free of cost under revised policy; validity of sale transactions under Telangana Tenancy Act, 1950 Sections 47 and 50-B; Government Order M.S. No.1406 of 1958 governing non-alienability; High Court's failure to appreciate non-transferable nature of assigned lands; reliance on Gudepu Sailoo and Yadaiah judgments; misconstruction of permission under Section 47 as proof of market value assignment.
legal_provisions_cited: Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfer) Act, 1977 s.3(2)
Telangana Area Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, 1950 s.47, s.50-B
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; resumption of lands upheld.
